headline: NextDC Shares Shed 44% on Revenue Delay
summary: Australian AI data centre operator NextDC saw its shares fall 44%, wiping about A$3.1 billion from its market value in early trade following a revenue delay.
why: Data centers are critical physical infrastructure underpinning cloud computing and artificial intelligence growth.

impacts.name: NextDC
impacts.why: Delayed revenue recognition directly hits investor sentiment and share valuation for infrastructure providers.

why_moved: A sharp drop in market value followed the announcement of revenue delays for key data center projects.
